title: Collatz steps
description:
Read a whole number n greater than 0. Repeat: if n is even, halve it; if it is odd, make it 3n + 1. Stop at 1. Print every number on one line separated by spaces, starting with n itself, then the number of steps on a second line.

```
Start? 6
6 3 10 5 16 8 4 2 1
8 steps
```

solution.main.lua:
io.write("Start? ")
local n = io.read("n")
local steps = 0
io.write(n)
while n ~= 1 do
    if n % 2 == 0 then
        n = n // 2
    else
        n = 3 * n + 1
    end
    steps = steps + 1
    io.write(" ", n)
end
print()
print(steps .. " steps")

hints: Use `n // 2`, not `n / 2`: `/` gives a float, and the numbers would print as `3.0`.
A `while n ~= 1 do` loop stops as soon as n reaches 1, and runs zero times when you start at 1.
